steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: GDP = C+I+G+(X-M); Real = nominal/deflatorx100; Deflator = nominal/realx100

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: AD: C (wealth, confidence, rates), I (confidence, rates, tech), G (policy), X-M (exchange rate, world income)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: SRAS: sticky wages/prices; LRAS: vertical at Yf (classical) or upward (Keynesian); AS shifts: costs, productivity

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Inflation: demand-pull (AD>AS), cost-push (AS left); CPI basket vs RPI (housing); costs: menu, shoe-leather, uncertainty

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Using AD/AS, analyse the effect of a rise in oil prices on price level and real output --- Solution: Oil price rise -> production costs ↑ -> SRAS shifts left. Result: price level rises (cost-push inflation), real output falls (stagflation). If central bank accommodates (AD↑), output restored but inflation higher. If not, recession
